get.description: Validates state before provider error, code and PKCE checks using existing handler logic. Success navigates to the frontend base URL, or /terms?new=true for new users, and sets authentication cookies. Failure navigates to /auth/callback?status=access_denied|provider_error|state_missing|state_invalid|code_missing|pkce_missing|code_invalid|token_exchange_failed|google_unavailable|userinfo_failed|internal_error. No tokens or raw provider errors enter the URL. Not a JSON query operation.

delete.description: No request body. Access cookie is checked first; Bearer is considered only when that cookie is absent, not invalid/empty. Access authentication precedes CSRF verification. Requires allowed Origin and matching signed CSRF cookie/header bound to Refresh. Revokes only this device; other sessions remain. An already-issued Access token may remain valid for its remaining 900s lifetime; ordinary Access validation does not query the DB. Success clears all three cookies with Max-Age=0, rather than renewing them.

delete.summary: Revoke this device's refresh session and clear authentication cookies

post.description: No request body. Refresh cookie only; Bearer is not accepted. Requires allowed Origin and matching CSRF cookie/header signed for the session and Refresh token. CSRF checks precede session lookup. Refresh expires after 604800s, extended on rotation. Rotation locks the device row; replay of the previous token revokes that session. Expired sessions clear authentication cookies; other 401/403 responses do not promise cookie changes.
